profile.summary: The Emerging Bilingual Collaborative is a coalition of foundations that supports multilingual learners in California's public schools, especially in preschool through third grade. It was started in 2019 and gives grants to school districts, charter schools and county offices of education to improve how teachers instruct children learning English. It is a sponsored project of New Venture Fund.
